description: Check a list of URLs for syntax problems before a crawler, sitemap or link checker uses them: missing scheme, non-numeric port, embedded space. Reports one entry per line with its issues, and notes a mixed-case host without counting it as broken. Choose this when you have a list of URLs and want the syntax problems listed per line — missing scheme, a non-numeric port, an embedded space or a mixed-case host — before a crawler or link checker consumes them. Do not choose this when you need to know whether a URL is reachable: the service makes no network request and cannot report liveness. Example requests: Check this list of URLs for typos before I run the crawler. | Which of these URLs are malformed and why? | Sanity-check my sitemap URLs before I submit them.

content.description: The customer's urls.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one URL per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.
